name: Porto Alegre

queries.query: Porto Alegre mapas digitais lotes fiscais DMWEB prefeitura SMF parcelas GIS
queries.scope: Locate an official municipal lot layer and current public feature service.
queries.result: The municipal Mapas Digitais/+Dados platform exposes the SMAMUS ArcGIS publication dmweb_lotes_fiscais, described as Lotes Fiscais and sourced from SMF Porto Alegre. The direct feature layer returns full polygon geometry.

queries.query: Porto Alegre Brazil official fiscal lot parcel polygon GIS ArcGIS municipal map
queries.scope: Cross-check English indexing for city-owned parcel data and the direct service.
queries.result: Found the official municipal ArcGIS layer; no separate English portal or data contract was needed to verify its geometry endpoint.

portals.name: Mapas Digitais / +Dados Porto Alegre
portals.operator: Prefeitura de Porto Alegre; SMAMUS map portal with SMF-sourced fiscal lot publication
portals.observation: Municipal map portal links the city GIS publication. Layer metadata identifies Lotes Fiscais, polygon geometry, and the SMF source; metadata and query support GeoJSON and pagination.

requests.observation: Layer metadata describes an esriGeometryPolygon layer; supports pagination and GeoJSON. Safe requested fields used for samples: objectid,id_lotes,setor,qtd.

Bounded overlap diagnosis returned 8 full Polygon records for six id_lotes values using only objectid and id_lotes plus geometry; IDs 75489 and 165601 recur under separate OIDs, and several distinct-ID overlaps remain unexplained.
Exact WUP point returned two complete Polygon features with safe attributes only; both native id_lotes=170121 under object IDs 410396 and 367988, 320 coordinates each.

verifiedParcelResponse.locationBasis: Exact WUP centroid query; the queue point is a population-weighted settlement centroid, not a municipal boundary or coverage claim.
verifiedParcelResponse.attributePolicy: Only safe GIS IDs and geometry retained; no owner/address fields requested.
verifiedParcelResponse.observation: Two complete Polygon features returned for the exact WUP point; both share id_lotes 170121 under separate object IDs, each with 320 coordinates.

source.name: Porto Alegre municipal fiscal lots (SMF) via SMAMUS DMWEB
source.operator: Prefeitura de Porto Alegre municipal GIS publication; source is identified as SMF Porto Alegre.
source.serviceType: Public ArcGIS FeatureServer polygon layer supporting bounded GeoJSON queries and pagination.
source.outputCrs: GeoJSON WGS 84 for stored samples; metric audit EPSG:32722.
source.nativeIdEvidence: Layer returns id_lotes and objectid; exact queries by the native ID returned shapes. Duplicate IDs under distinct object IDs and material overlaps remain unexplained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal fiscal lot dataset published by Porto Alegre; city portal description and layer metadata identify the municipal context.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A full polygon was returned at the WUP centroid, and the repository adapter passed all 13 bounded 0.001° cells plus pagination, exact-ID reads, absence, footprint, and binding checks. This bounded sample does not establish full municipal completeness.

technicalBlocker: Independent GEOS audit on 139 unmodified unique shapes found 20 positive-area overlap pairs totaling 27,473.94 m² and 0 invalid geometries. A bounded native query confirmed near-coincident duplicate-like shapes under different IDs/object IDs and several distinct-ID overlaps; the service metadata does not explain lifecycle or layer grouping. Keep runtime held until the source owner documents the unit/record contract. Do not filter or repair shapes.
remainingUncertainty: Whether duplicate and overlapping fiscal features represent duplicate records, lifecycle states, or distinct legal/tax units; citywide completeness and the queue identity review are also unresolved.
nextStep: Request source-owner documentation for id_lotes/objectid lifecycle and grouping semantics, then requalify overlaps without arbitrary status/year/type filters. Keep the three existing safe geometry samples only and do not integrate pending review.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

runtimeAssessment.reason: The direct public sample and adapter protocol pass, but independent GEOS found substantial unresolved overlaps and the source lacks a documented lifecycle/grouping contract.

registryBasis: The official municipal map portal publishes SMF-sourced fiscal lot polygons; a complete public polygon was returned.
